import json, inspect
program = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row} - {bg}
    candidates = []
    for v in colors:
        pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, x in enumerate(row) if x == v]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in pts)
        r1 = max(r for r, c in pts)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in pts)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in pts)
        others = {grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)} - {bg, v}
        candidates.append((len(others), v, (r0, r1, c0, c1)))
    _, v, (r0, r1, c0, c1) = min(candidates)
    mask = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, x in enumerate(row) if x not in (bg, v)]
    a = min(r for r, c in pts)
    b = max(r for r, c in pts)
    c = min(c for r, c in pts)
    d = max(c for r, c in pts)
    tile = [row[c:d + 1] for row in grid[a:b + 1]]
    out = []
    for r in range(len(mask)):
        for tr in range(len(tile)):
            row = []
            for col in range(len(mask[0])):
                row.extend(tile[tr] if mask[r][col] == v else [bg] * len(tile[0]))
            out.append(row)
    return out
'''
